projects.title: Green Vision
projects.shortDescription: AI-driven environmental and security monitoring for smart parks.
projects.description: Designed an end-to-end AI solution to monitor environmental and security conditions in smart parks using Python, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and YOLO models.
projects.problem: Urban parks need real-time monitoring of air quality, suspicious activity, and environmental changes without requiring dense manual oversight.
projects.solution: Implemented an AI-powered monitoring pipeline that identifies risk events, tracks environmental signals, and surfaces actionable insights through an interface.

projects.title: SQLite RAG AI Agent
projects.shortDescription: Natural-language querying over SQLite databases using LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation.
projects.description: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system that allows natural language interaction with a SQLite database and generates contextual answers.
projects.problem: Users often lack SQL proficiency and need a simpler way to explore structured data.
projects.solution: Used an LLM pipeline with schema-aware retrieval and contextual prompts to convert user intent into database-aware responses.

projects.title: Pneumonia Detection
projects.shortDescription: Medical AI system for chest X-ray analysis and pneumonia detection.
projects.description: A medical imaging model using YOLOv8 and OpenCV to detect pneumonia markers from chest X-ray images, covering the full pipeline from dataset preparation to evaluation.
projects.problem: Medical image review is time-intensive and error-prone without AI assistance.
projects.solution: Built a vision pipeline that preprocesses, detects, and evaluates pneumonia indicators in medical imagery.
